rows.text_1_facilitator:
Today's topic is about helping your teen learn.

Did you know that spending one-on-one time with your teen can help them do better at school? Today we will share some ideas about how you can support your teen to learn in school and outside of school.

media_transcript.eng:

Today's topic is helping your teen to learn.

rows.text_1_facilitator:
Schools teach teens important skills, but learning does not stop at school, it can happen anywhere. 

Parents help teens learn through daily life with family and friends and during fun. Often, learning starts by simply spending time together.

character_1_text.eng: I don’t want to go to school today.

rows.character_1_text: I hate school. Why should I go to school if you didn’t?

character_2_text.eng:
You know how your uncle always has many foods on the table? I work just as hard as he does, but our table often does not have as many foods. School gave him more chances than I had.

School also helped him feel confident and get along with different types of people. I want those things for you, too.

rows.text_1_facilitator: Here are some skills you can use to help your teen learn!

text_1_facilitator.eng: Here are some skills you can use to help your teen learn!

section_1_text.eng: Help your teen build a simple homework routine at home, like setting aside a regular time or place for homework. This helps strengthen what they learned at school and teaches them how to manage their time.

section_2_text.eng: Support your teen’s learning at home by making study time calm and focused. Turn off phones, keep the house as quiet as possible, encourage breaks when needed, and show interest and excitement by asking your teen what they are interested in learning.

section_3_text.eng: Praising your teen is a powerful way to help them try again. Teens often do not get things right the first time and should learn how to try again. Praise them for trying to do things, so they can learn from their mistakes.

media_title.eng: Spending time together helped @data.characters.media_male_1.name and his father connect. Listen to their story

media_transcript.eng:
Before, my father got very angry when I did not get good grades at school. Since he started using @global.app_name, he makes more time to chat with me.

I told him that school makes me very stressed. He explained that when you are too stressed, it is hard to think clearly. Now, when he sees I am stressed, we go outside and play soccer together. It helps me calm down and finish my work better.

My father did not finish school, but he is one of the reasons that I will.

rows.media_title: Spending time together helped @data.characters.media_male_1.name and his father connect. Listen to their story
rows.media_transcript:
Before, my father got very angry when I did not get good grades at school. Since he started using @global.app_name, he makes more time to chat with me.

I told him that school makes me very stressed. He explained that when you are too stressed, it is hard to think clearly. Now, when he sees I am stressed, we go outside and play soccer together. It helps me calm down and finish my work better.

My father did not finish school, but he is one of the reasons that I will.
